channel.title: Anup Salve — Writing & Research
channel.description: Staff-level UI engineering, fine-grained reactivity, web performance, and constitutional law essays by Anup Salve.

item.title: Fine-Grained Reactivity and the Evolution of UI Runtimes
item.description: An architectural dissection of signals, dependency graphs, and the elimination of wasteful dirty checking in modern browser engines.

item.title: Accessibility as System Architecture: Beyond the ARIA Crutch
item.description: Why retrofitting ARIA attributes onto defective semantic hierarchies fails, and how to design accessible component topologies from first principles.

item.title: Constitutional Frameworks for Digital Sovereignty & Algorithmic Due Process
item.description: Examining procedural due process, automated decision-making systems, and the imperative for verifiable transparency in public software infrastructures.

item.title: Software Patents vs. The Open Source Commons: An Architectural & Jurisprudential Analysis
item.description: Evaluating the doctrinal friction between software patent claims and mathematical abstractions under the Alice/Mayo framework.

item.title: Micro-Frontend Orchestration: Memory Leak Containment and State Hydration
item.description: Engineering resilient multi-team frontend platforms without ballooning JavaScript payloads or compromising isolated runtime execution.

item.title: The Cognitive Tax of Modern Interfaces: On Restraint and Calm Computing
item.description: How visual noise, aggressive notifications, and unnecessary micro-interactions exhaust human attentional bandwidth.
